title: The Foreign Office
note: Two messengers now carry the fort's letters abroad. First stop: The Fatal Empire, where our envoy made contact and opened trade.

title: The Indoor Pasture
note: The herd now lives indoors under the hills, grazing on cave moss, out of the rain and away from ambushes.

title: Booze at the Bar
note: The tavern's own stockpile now holds barrels of drink instead of leftover meals, so the keeper pours without a trip to the cellar.

title: Nest Boxes for the Indoor Pasture
note: Nest boxes go up against the walls of the new indoor pasture, about one for every three hens.

title: One Public Tavern
note: The fort's first tavern now welcomes travellers. Every other hall stays members-only.

title: Faces for the Herald
note: The Herald now prints a proper portrait of whoever is on camera.

title: Where Is the Caravan?
note: The trade office now gives merchants a generous deal so the Mountainhome caravans come back, and our messengers ride out to open trade with the humans, elves and other dwarves.

title: Goods the Mountainhomes Want
note: Make what the liaison asks for before the next caravan, and sign the trade agreements.
